Bug_Title: Regular expressions should be syntactically valid
Bug_Explanation: The provided regular expressions contain syntax errors because they contain unclosed brackets or parentheses, which are special characters in regex syntax. This results in a PatternSyntaxException at runtime.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by attempting to use invalid regular expressions that cause a PatternSyntaxException. The test case directly invokes the error-prone lines from the showBug method in the RegexSyntaxErrorExample class, thus causing the test to fail.
